rows.source_citation: Chen, Deng, Zhao & Yan (2020), ISIJ International 60(8), 1602–1609, doi:10.2355/isijinternational.ISIJINT-2019-683
rows.source_locator: Eq. (3), p. 1608; Table 2, p. 1607; 17 unstarred compositions only
limitations: Eq. (3) uses weight-percent inputs: ln(gamma_Ce2O3) = 3.46*((wt% CaO + 0.72*wt% Al2O3)/wt% SiO2) - 14.93.
Closure RMS is 0.2919 in ln(gamma) against the 17 unstarred Table 2 activities; the two starred inherited comparison rows are excluded.
The central standard conversion uses the direct G°_Ce2O3(l)(T) − G°_A(T) difference. The gamma band combines closure RMS and the three transition enthalpy uncertainties in quadrature in ln(gamma).
The 28 +/-8, 19 +/-5 and 85 +/-10 kJ/mol transition enthalpies are source estimates; the fusion enthalpy is based on La2O3 analogue entropies, not a direct Ce2O3 measurement.

The activity standard is pure solid Ce2O3 inherited from Zhao et al. 2019. The engine parent uses pure liquid Ce2O3(l); this empirical equation is a single-temperature, CMAS-like screen, not a validated Fe-bearing law.
